pyproject.toml:47 allows pandas>=2.0,<4; requirements.txt:79 pins pandas==3.1.0. DataFrame.isetitem (added in pandas 1.5) sets the column at a positional index with the given values, replacing it rather than writing into the old array. DataFrame.attrs is an assignable dict property (since 1.0) and copy() propagates it via __finalize__. masking.py:160-166 relies on isetitem for replacement and on attrs assignment, and explicitly re-sets attrs from df.attrs, so it does not depend on propagation. All of this holds across the whole allowed range (>=2.0). This is from knowledge of the pandas API; I did not run pandas.
